Deeply saddened by the devastating earthquake in Mindanao, Philippines, which has resulted in the tragic loss of precious lives and caused widespread damage. 

We extend our heartfelt condolences to the bereaved families and pray for the swift recovery of those injured. Pakistan

对菲律宾棉兰老岛发生毁灭性地震，造成宝贵生命的悲惨损失和广泛破坏深感悲痛。 

我们向遇难者家属表示诚挚慰问，并祈祷伤者早日康复。巴基斯坦
